q: A runaway 601 is not an Amber Alert. Amber is a listed abduction / danger package, not every missing teen.
Hate-crime IR rules still apply when the victim or suspect is a juvenile. Confidentiality of the juvenile file does not mean 'no IR.'
ex: Manual 4 hate crime + WIC 827 on who sees the file.

q: Campus threat / bomb-at-school: SO22 plus FOG bomb distances. The school is not 'just another building' for notifications.
The Juvenile Arrest Supplemental Report exists because a 5.2 adult arrest face sheet does not capture required juvenile fields.
ex: SO11 activated/revised that form path. Use the current form.

q: A 14-year-old 602 robbery suspect is still a juvenile for housing, advisement, and court. Age 18 is the adult-booking line unless a listed exception applies.
ex: Do not 'book adult because the crime was ugly.'

q: If the minor invokes or counsel is required under 625.6, questioning stops. 'We just need to find the gun for public safety' is not a blank check — read the current public-safety exception law.
ex: WC should get a supervisor and, if needed, detective/charging advice.

q: Notifications to a school after a student arrest follow current Manual / school-notification rules. Do not post the arrest on the Area social account.
A WC who finds a 16-year-old in the adult tank with no segregation plan fixes it immediately and documents. That is not a 'next watch' problem.
Found-person / located-runaway still needs the missing-person system updated. Closing the radio call is not closing NCIC.
Interviewing a child victim of sexual abuse is not a 'get a full statement in the back seat' job. Follow current SECU / Juvenile / DCFS protocol.
A private-person arrest of a juvenile still needs WC booking review. The citizen does not pick 601 vs 602.
ex: WC classifies and accepts or refuses custody under Manual rules.

q: Curfew and truancy are typically 601-type problems, not automatic 602 felonies.
The Lieutenant exam bulletin lists arrest, detention, and disposition of prisoners and the Juvenile Diversion Program as testable knowledge. Juvenile is not 'detective-only trivia.'
ex: City Personnel bulletin for Police Lieutenant 2232.

q: Treat a probationer the same way for notification: if the booking package shows formal probation, the WC ensures the probation officer / agency is notified per current Manual practice.
ex: Do not wait until filing. Holds die when nobody calls.

q: Penal Code 1203 is the adult probation-granting statute. Know the word 'probation' in a package means a court-ordered grant, not 'he's on a program.'
ex: Read current 1203 if the question is statutory.

q: PC 1203.2 authorizes arrest of a probationer for a violation, including in many cases without a warrant when the officer has probable cause the person violated probation.
ex: Read the current text for peace-officer vs probation-officer language.

q: A probation search condition is not a general warrant to search every roommate's locked room. Stay inside the condition and the nexus.
ex: Fourth Amendment + the written terms. Document the condition you relied on.

q: PRCS (Post Release Community Supervision) is not the same thing as formal probation. Do not write 'probation hold' when the sheet says PRCS.
ex: PRCS is a post-realignment supervision status. Call the right agency.

q: Parole is CDCR / DAPO. Adult probation is the county probation department. Juvenile probation is also county probation, different unit.
A 'no-bail probation hold' is placed by the supervising agency or the court, not invented on the booking slip by the arresting officer.
ex: WC confirms the hold is real before telling the jail it is no-bail.

q: Felony-warrant narratives are required when there is a parole or probation hold (among other listed exceptions).
If two sergeants argue about extending a stop on a probationer, the WC decides with the condition sheet and PC — not who is louder.
A probation officer in the field is not automatically the incident commander at your crime scene.
ex: ICS / scene ownership stays with the police IC until transferred.
src: EOG / ICS command; probation is a cooperating agency

q: Sharing a juvenile 602 file with the minor's probation officer is a WIC 827 analysis, not an open-records dump.
ex: 827 lists who may inspect. Probation is often a listed party — confirm before you email the PDF to a personal account.

q: Juvenile formal probation is a court disposition after a 602 finding (or equivalent). It is not the same as informal 'station diversion.'
src: WIC 602 disposition / Juvenile Diversion bulletin area

q: Home supervision / electronic monitoring of a juvenile is a probation-department tool. LAPD does not 'cut the bracelet off' in the field without that agency.
src: County juvenile probation practice; WC notification

q: Flash incarceration (short jail hit as a sanction) is a supervision tool. It is not a new 602 for every dirty test unless charging says so.
ex: Know the difference: sanction vs new crime.

q: Mandatory supervision under 1170(h) is not classic 1203 probation. Use the right label on the IR and the hold request.
ex: Realignment statuses matter on a Lieutenant exam.

q: An interstate compact probationer is still a probationer. Do not ignore the out-of-state packet because 'that's not our PO.'
If the probationer is also a registered 290, supervision status does not cancel sex-offender index rules. Do not give index data by phone.
A PO asking you to 'just kick the door because he's on search terms' still needs you to confirm the condition, the address, and who lives there.
ex: You own the Fourth Amendment decision.

q: Probation violation and a new crime can both exist. Book the new crime; let the PO place the violation hold. Do not pick only the hold and dump the 211.
When a juvenile on probation is arrested for a new 602, notify the assigned juvenile PO as well as parents/DSVD as required.
ex: Two systems: police booking + probation supervision.

q: A probation search of a phone is not automatically covered because 'he's on paper.' Look at the written electronics condition.
ex: Riley + the four corners of the terms.

q: Do not hold a probationer extra hours 'until the PO gets to work at 0800' if you have no crime, no hold, and no PC.
If the PO wants the person released to a program instead of jail, that is a custody decision with the WC / jail — not a field officer freelance drop-off.
Adult probation officers are peace officers under designated code sections for their duties. That does not make them LAPD supervisors.
ex: They do not outrank your sergeant on an LAPD scene.

q: A 'probation search' documented with no mention of the actual condition will get shredded in a motion. Write the words from the terms.
ex: Report writing is a Lieutenant exam neighbor of supervision.

q: If records show expired probation, you do not get a 1203.2 arrest on a lapsed grant. Confirm status before you sell the hold to the jail.
Gang conditions (stay-away, no colors) are probation terms, not a separate LAPD gang file. Still follow 4/721.15 on who maintains gang books.
A victim of a probationer's new DV still gets a DVV pamphlet and Marsy card. Supervision status of the suspect changes nothing for the victim.
Do not use the probationer as your CI while he is in your back seat on a hold. Informant rules still apply; uniformed officers do not keep CIs.
If the arrest is only a probation violation with no new crime, say so on the face sheet. Do not invent a 148 to make it look like a fresh felony.
County jail and juvenile hall are different receiving points. A 16-year-old on juvenile probation does not go to Men's Central 'because he's big.'
When RACR / DSVD is needed on a juvenile probation arrest after hours, use the same after-hours path you use for other juvenile bookings.
A search condition does not authorize a strip search. Strip-search rules in an administrative or jail context are separate Manual sections.
ex: Manual 3/839.22 is employee strips; arrestee strips have their own rules — do not mix them.

q: If the PO is the reporting party on a violation and there is no new victim crime, you may still need an IR or a booking package. 'Verbal only' is a WC call based on current Manual.
Firearms and probation: many grants bar possession. That is a condition plus, often, a separate crime if a prohibited person. Charge what the facts support.
ex: Do not assume every probationer is 29800 PC without the record.

q: A Lieutenant reviewing TEAMS / complaint history still looks at how supervisors handled probation-related searches and holds. Bad searches become 1.28s.
Do not conference the probationer and the victim together 'so they can work it out' on a DV or child-abuse case.
If ICE asks about a probationer, TRUST / ILO / RACR rules still apply. Supervision status is not a detainer.
A bench warrant for violation of probation is a warrant. Serve and book it like a warrant, plus notify the PO.
Juvenile probation camps and halls set intake rules. LAPD does not override medical/intake refusal by yelling rank.
ex: Document the refusal and call DSVD / the WC.

q: 'On searchable probation' said by a gang officer is not proof. Pull the terms or have records confirm before you search.
ex: The motion will ask what you actually knew.

q: If the probationer is injured in custody, injured-arrestee rules (SO30 / Manual) still apply. Paper status does not cancel an RA.
A PO's request for a welfare check on a juvenile probationer is still a police response with Department tactics — not a guaranteed door-kick.
Disposition of a 602 (home on probation, camp, etc.) is the court's call. Field officers do not promise 'you'll just get informal.'
ex: Don't bargain dispositions you don't control.

q: When the booking charge is only 1203.2, list the underlying grant and the violation facts in the narrative.
A Lieutenant on a pursuit or UOF involving a probationer still runs the Department pursuit/UOF policy. Status on paper is not an exception.
Do not release a juvenile to 'his PO said it's fine' without following Department release-from-custody and parent/guardian rules.
src: Manual Vol. 4 release from custody; juveniles

q: AB 109 / realignment changed who supervises many people formerly on state parole. If the sheet says probation or mandatory supervision, call the county, not CDCR by habit.
The WC log should show probation/parole notification time, agency, and person notified when a hold or felony booking requires it.
ex: If it is not on the log, it did not happen for the exam or the lawsuit.

q: A probation officer’s field notes are not a substitute for your IR. If LAPD takes a crime report, write the Department report.
ex: Two agencies, two records. Do not assume the PO’s chrono covers your 3.01.
